title: Admin Dashboard mobile layout fixes + independent scrolling (Motorola G5/G5 Ace)

requirements.summary: Make the admin layout responsive on small Android phones to avoid cut-off, overlap, and horizontal overflow across all admin routes.
acceptanceCriteria: On Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace sized viewports, visiting /admin and each existing /admin/* route shows a usable layout with no clipped content and no required horizontal scrolling.
Admin pages keep readable spacing and tap targets on narrow screens (e.g., ~360–412px width) while preserving the existing theme styles.
No regressions on tablet and desktop: sidebar + content layout still works at md/lg breakpoints.

file_operations.description: Refactor the admin shell to be mobile-first (e.g., stack sidebar above content on small screens, restore side-by-side at md+), add min-w-0/overflow-x-hidden safeguards on flex children, and adjust paddings/gaps for narrow tap targets while preserving existing theme classes.

Make the Products table mobile-friendly to avoid horizontal overflow (e.g., hide/deprioritize non-essential columns on small screens and ensure long text wraps) so /admin/products remains usable at ~360–412px widths.
Make the Portfolio table mobile-friendly to avoid horizontal overflow (e.g., responsive column visibility and wrapping) so /admin/portfolio remains usable on narrow screens.
Make the Testimonials table mobile-friendly to avoid horizontal overflow (e.g., responsive column visibility and wrapping) so /admin/testimonials remains usable on narrow screens.

Adjust giveaway admin page responsive layout to prevent horizontal overflow from long principal strings (e.g., responsive column behavior and wrapping) and ensure cards/grids stack cleanly on small Android phones.
Tighten the verification code management page container for mobile (e.g., add mobile padding and ensure inputs/buttons fit without overflow) while keeping existing UI/verification behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure the main admin content area reliably scrolls vertically on mobile across all admin pages.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewports, admin page content (e.g., /admin/products with table, /admin/giveaways, /admin/portfolio) can be scrolled vertically from top to bottom.
No element (e.g., fixed containers) prevents page scrolling; no ‘stuck’ scroll behavior occurs in mobile browsers.

file_operations.description: Change the admin shell height/overflow model for mobile to support reliable vertical scrolling (e.g., use a dvh-based shell height and set the <main> content region to overflow-y-auto), ensuring scroll is not blocked by fixed-height containers.

Add a small, targeted CSS helper for smoother mobile scrolling behavior in the admin content area (e.g., iOS/Android momentum scrolling where applicable) without altering the overall theme or touching shadcn/ui files.

requirements.summary: Make the left admin navigation independently scrollable so all nav items are reachable on short mobile screens.
acceptanceCriteria: When the admin navigation list is taller than the available viewport height, the navigation area can be scrolled independently (overflow-y) to reach the last item.
The nav title/header area (e.g., “Admin Panel”) does not prevent scrolling to the bottom nav items on small heights.
Keyboard/touch scrolling works in the sidebar nav on mobile without also forcing horizontal scrolling.

file_operations.description: Restructure the sidebar as a flex column with a fixed header section and a scrollable nav section (overflow-y-auto) so the nav list can scroll independently and reach bottom items like “Verification Codes” on short screens.
Add a targeted CSS utility/class for the admin sidebar scroll container (e.g., enabling momentum scrolling and preventing accidental horizontal scroll) to improve touch scrolling on mobile browsers.

requirements.summary: Update the QA checklist with explicit Motorola G5/G5 Ace admin layout and scrolling verification steps.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/QA-CHECKLIST.md includes a dedicated Admin Dashboard mobile section that mentions Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace (or their viewport sizes) and includes checkboxes for: (1) main admin content vertical scroll, (2) left admin navigation independent scroll, and (3) ability to reach the bottom-most nav item.
Checklist steps are written in clear English and are specific enough to reproduce/verify the fix.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated Admin Dashboard mobile QA section referencing Motorola G5 and Motorola G5 Ace (or equivalent viewport sizes) with clear checkboxes for verifying: (1) main content vertical scrolling, (2) independent sidebar nav scrolling, and (3) reaching the bottom-most nav item (e.g., “Verification Codes”) on short screens.
